name: kb_eval_v1
description: 知识库评测集 v1：基于两份文档（Massive Activations 论文、虚构的差旅报销制度）编写，含可回答题与不可回答题。题目与证据由 Claude 起草，需人工复核。
relevance_rule: 检索结果（子块或其母块）去掉所有空白并转小写后，包含任意一条 evidence（同样处理）即视为命中

sources.doc_name: Massive Activations in Large Language Models.pdf

items.question: In LLaMA2-7B, which two feature dimensions contain massive activations?
items.reference_answer: Feature dimensions 1415 and 2533.
evidence: two feature dimensions (1415 and 2533)

items.question: Which feature dimensions hold massive activations in LLaMA2-13B, and at which tokens?
items.reference_answer: Dimensions 2100 and 4743, located only at the starting token.

items.question: Which feature dimensions contain massive activations in Mixtral-8x7B?
items.reference_answer: Dimensions 2070 and 3398.

items.question: In LLaMA2-7B, in which layer do massive activations first appear and until which layer do they stay nearly constant?
items.reference_answer: They first appear in layer 2 and remain nearly constant until layer 30.
evidence: first appear in layer 2 and remain nearly constant values until layer 30

items.question: What loose definition does the paper give for a massive activation?
items.reference_answer: An activation whose magnitude exceeds 100 and is at least (or around) 1,000 times larger than the median magnitude of its hidden state.
evidence: magnitude surpasses 100 and is at least or around 1,000 times larger than the median

items.question: What happens to LLaMA2-7B when its massive activations are set to zero?
items.reference_answer: Performance collapses: perplexity on WikiText, C4 and PG-19 becomes infinite and mean zero-shot accuracy drops from 68.95% to 36.75%.
evidence: Set to zero inf inf inf 36.75%
significant degradation in model performance

items.question: What is the effect of setting massive activations to their mean values?
items.reference_answer: Negligible change in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy, showing they act like constant bias terms.
evidence: negligible changes in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy

items.question: How do massive activations differ conceptually from outlier features?
items.reference_answer: A massive activation is a single scalar value at specific tokens, while an outlier feature is a vector (a feature dimension) with large values at most tokens.
evidence: a massive activation is a scalar value, determined jointly by the sequence and feature dimensions

items.question: How many outlier features did the authors find in LLaMA2-7B and LLaMA2-13B, and do they overlap with massive activation dimensions?
items.reference_answer: 10 and 25 outlier features respectively, and none of them correspond to the feature dimensions of massive activations.
evidence: We discover 10 and 25 outlier features in these two models respectively

items.question: According to Table 1, what is the top-1 activation magnitude in Mixtral-8x7B?
items.reference_answer: 7100.0 (median about 0.3).

items.question: What data did the authors use to locate massive activations across layers?
items.reference_answer: 100 sequences of 4,096 tokens each, collected from RedPajama.
evidence: we collect 100 sequences (each with 4,096 tokens) from RedPajama

items.question: Why might massive activations appear at the starting token?
items.reference_answer: Every autoregressive training instance contains an initial token, and it is the only token used in all forward passes within a sequence.
evidence: the starting token is the only token used in all forward passes within a sequence

items.question: Why might LLMs store these biases in delimiter tokens?
items.reference_answer: Delimiter tokens carry relatively low semantic value, so repurposing them to store biases is low cost.
evidence: relatively low semantic value of these tokens

items.question: In LLaMA2-7B, from which layer is attention concentrated on the tokens with massive activations?
items.reference_answer: From layer 3 onward (e.g., layer 31), attention mostly concentrates on the two tokens associated with massive activations.
evidence: in layer 3 and deeper layers (e.g., layer 31), attention is mostly concentrated

items.question: What normalization variant does LLaMA2 use?
items.reference_answer: RMSNorm, a variant of layer normalization.
evidence: LLaMA2 uses a variant of layer normalization: RMSNorm

items.question: What do the value updates from the tokens with massive activations look like across different tokens?
items.reference_answer: They are nearly identical across tokens, acting as additive bias terms in the attention output.
evidence: are nearly identical across tokens

items.question: How do the authors add explicit attention biases to self-attention?
items.reference_answer: They add learnable key and value vectors k' and v' per head, concatenated with the key and value matrices.
evidence: concatenated with the key and value matrices

items.question: Which three GPT-2 variants were trained in the explicit attention bias experiment?
items.reference_answer: A standard GPT-2, GPT-2 prepended with a sink token, and GPT-2 with explicit attention biases.
evidence: GPT-2 prepended with a sink token

items.question: Do massive activations appear in GPT-2 trained with explicit attention biases?
items.reference_answer: No. They disappear, while the standard and sink-token GPT-2 still have them; all three reach the same performance.
evidence: in GPT-2 with explicit attention biases, massive activations disappear

items.question: Which ViT-L models exhibit massive activations and which do not?
items.reference_answer: CLIP and DINOv2 ViT-L exhibit them; MAE ViT-L does not.
evidence: we do not observe massive activations in MAE ViT-L
massive activations exist in CLIP and DINOv2 ViT-L

items.question: What is observed in MAE ViT-L instead of massive activations?
items.reference_answer: Feature dimension 927 has uniformly large values across all tokens.
evidence: a feature dimension (927) exhibits uniformly large values across all tokens

items.question: At which layer was the intervention on CLIP ViT-L performed?
items.reference_answer: Layer 13, where massive activations first appear in that model.
evidence:
The intervention is conducted on layer
13

items.question: Where do massive activations appear in DINOv2-reg ViT-G?
items.reference_answer: Exclusively within a fixed register token, register 3, not in patch tokens.
evidence: exclusively within a fixed register token, i.e., register 3

items.question: What is the ImageNet accuracy of DINOv2-reg ViT-G before and after fixing register features to their means?
items.reference_answer: 87.0% in both cases.

items.question: What practical implication does the paper mention for model quantization?
items.reference_answer: Large-magnitude activations are a major challenge for quantizing LLMs; the paper identifies a new type of outlier activation relevant to compression.
evidence: major challenge in effectively quantizing LLMs

items.question: Why were the explicit attention bias experiments limited to a small GPT-2?
items.reference_answer: Because of computational resource constraints.
evidence: limited to a small GPT-2 model due to computational resource constraints

items.question: LLaMA2-7B 中的大规模激活（massive activations）出现在哪两个特征维度？
items.reference_answer: 1415 和 2533 两个特征维度。
evidence: two feature dimensions (1415 and 2533)

items.question: 把大规模激活置零会对 LLaMA2-7B 造成什么影响？
items.reference_answer: 模型性能崩溃：困惑度变为无穷大，平均零样本准确率从 68.95% 降到 36.75%。
evidence: Set to zero inf inf inf 36.75%
significant degradation in model performance

items.question: 这篇论文发表在哪个会议？
items.reference_answer: COLM 2024（First Conference on Language Modeling）。
evidence: First Conference on Language Modeling (COLM), 2024

items.question: MAE ViT-L 中有没有观察到大规模激活？
items.reference_answer: 没有；MAE ViT-L 中观察到的是第 927 个特征维度在所有 token 上都很大。
evidence: we do not observe massive activations in MAE ViT-L
a feature dimension (927) exhibits uniformly large values across all tokens

items.question: 为什么作者认为大规模激活起到了偏置项（bias）的作用？
items.reference_answer: 把它们设为均值几乎不影响困惑度和零样本准确率，说明它们的取值是与输入无关的常数，作用类似偏置项。
evidence: negligible changes in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy
functioning similarly to bias terms

items.question: 差旅报销需要提交哪些材料？
items.reference_answer: 审批通过的《出差申请单》、交通票据（机票行程单或火车票原件）、住宿增值税发票（抬头为公司全称）、本人签字的《差旅费报销单》。
evidence: 须提交以下材料

items.question: 出差结束后多久内要提交报销？逾期怎么办？
items.reference_answer: 15 个自然日内；超过 15 日须附情况说明并经分管副总批准；超过 60 日不予报销。
evidence: 15 个自然日内提交报销申请

items.question: 一线城市的住宿报销标准是多少？
items.reference_answer: 每晚不超过 600 元，超出部分员工自行承担。
evidence: 一线城市住宿费每晚不超过 600 元

items.question: 出差伙食补助是多少？需要发票吗？
items.reference_answer: 每人每天 100 元，无需提供发票。
evidence: 每人每天 100 元标准发放伙食补助

items.question: 没走审批就出差，费用能报销吗？
items.reference_answer: 不能，未经审批的出差费用不予报销。
evidence: 未经审批的出差费用不予报销

items.question: 报销款多久能到账？
items.reference_answer: 报销单经部门负责人、财务部审核后，财务部在 5 个工作日内打入员工工资卡。
evidence: 5 个工作日内将款项打入员工工资卡
